question: Shahi Atala Masjid is located in which of the following district of Uttar Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaunpur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Shahi Atala Masjid is a historical mosque located in **Jaunpur district**, Uttar Pradesh, India.
 
• It was constructed during the reign of **Ibrahim Shah Sharqi** in the 15th century (1408 AD).
 
• The mosque is an excellent example of **Sharqi architectural style**, blending Islamic and Indian design elements.
 
• The structure features massive gateways, intricate carvings, and a distinctive domed roof, making it a significant heritage site.
 
• It is one of the most iconic landmarks of Jaunpur and represents the city's rich historical and cultural legacy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sharqi Dynasty:** The Sharqi dynasty ruled Jaunpur from the late 14th century to the early 16th century and was known for its patronage of art and architecture.
 
• **Architectural Features:** The mosque exhibits features like domes, arches, and intricate calligraphy, which are typical of medieval Islamic architecture.
 
• **Jaunpur:** Often referred to as the "Shiraz of India," Jaunpur is historically renowned for its architectural marvels built during the Sharqi Sultanate.
 
• **Preservation Efforts:** Shahi Atala Masjid is recognized as a protected monument by the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI).
 
• **Cultural Importance:** The mosque not only serves as a place of worship but also attracts tourists and historians interested in medieval Indian architecture.
